label: Imaging Procedure
description: Any technology or method that aids in the visualization of any biological process, cell, tissue or organ for use in screening, diagnosis, surgical procedures or therapy.

verification.note: Schema node representing raw imaging data level 1; best NCIT match is Imaging Procedure as the general class for imaging activities. OBI:0003327 (image data set) is an alternative but NCIT is preferred per task instructions.

label: Primary Key
description: The attribute selected as being most important for uniquely identifying a body of information (an entity, object or record).

verification.note: Primary Key is a direct match for a unique row identifier used as a primary key for record updates.

label: Imaging Procedure
description: Any technology or method that aids in the visualization of any biological process, cell, tissue or organ for use in screening, diagnosis, surgical procedures or therapy.

verification.note: No exact NCIT term for 'imaging assay type' exists. Imaging Procedure is the best available parent class. CDE:7789196 is also noted in the existing model.

label: Imaging Process Protocol Element
description: A set of parameter values necessary to obtain or reconstruct a set of images for an imaging process protocol.

verification.note: No exact NCIT term for a protocol link/URL. Imaging Process Protocol Element is the closest match representing imaging protocol information.

label: Instrument Model
description: The name and/or number associated with a specific device style or design that was developed and built to carry out a specific function or set of functions.

verification.note: Instrument Model is a direct match for the specific model of the instrument used in the imaging experiment.

label: Manufacturer
description: A person, enterprise, or entity that produces finished goods.

verification.note: Manufacturer is a direct match for the producer of the imaging equipment.

label: Computer Program
description: A sequence of instructions written in a form understandable by a computer system that, when executed, tells the computer to perform a specific task or set of tasks.

verification.note: No exact NCIT term for imaging software. Computer Program (NCIT:C17146) is the best available parent class for a software package used to capture, generate, and process images.
